entries.definition: Deeds — not a synonym for obedience. A work becomes obedience when it executes God's command, or disobedience when another lawgiver governs it. Romans 4 uses the laborer's work offered for wages and debt; James 2 uses Abraham's work as faith made visible. Complete obedience still earns no wage: the servant has only done his duty.
entries.common_view: Commonly taught: in Paul's salvation texts, “works” broadly includes human obedience and effort set against faith; good works then follow salvation as its fruit and evidence.
entries.citations: (Ex 18:20; Ps 111:7; Mic 6:16; Luke 17:7-10; Rom 4:4-5; Jas 2:21-22) · see Love, Knowing, Faith & Belief, ch. 6
